## Repository and context

[Repository in my account](https://github.com/raxit65535/literate-garbanzo)

Network Pulse explores clustering interactions in GitHub event streams with a
distributed data pipeline. The upstream README describes the stream simulation,
filtering, graph-processing, persistence, and visualization components.

![Architecture illustration retained from the earlier portfolio record](/assets/about/projects/git-archive.jpg)

## Related authored publication

My 2019 CSUF thesis,
[Git-Archive Data Pipeline](../../publications/git-archive-data-pipeline/index.qmd),
is archived by ProQuest under publication number **13864765**. It addresses
scalable pipelines and streaming graph processing with Kafka and Flink.

The thesis has its own bibliographic record. Authorship of that thesis does not
replace the upstream attribution or establish which changes I made to this fork.
